newsitem.title: UK: BA to extend special cargo sale into April.
newsitem.headline: BA to extend special cargo sale into April.

text.p: British Airways is to continue into April some of its special "promotional" low air cargo rates, a BA spokesman said on Tuesday.
Details of the continued special deals are not yet available but are likely to follow the pattern of BA's earlier sales which have been in operation all this year.
All these have offered low rates for pallets or bins but have not been extended to loose parcels.
The current sale last until the end of this month and the spokesman said details of the new rates which would be applicable from April 1 were likely to be known on Thursday.

The 55 routes in the existing sale comprise 17 in BA's North Atlantic region, 3 in Latin America, 14 in its southern region covering the Middle East, East Africa and the Indian sub-continent, eight in the Pacific and 13 European routes.
